mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.api.AipMapper.getCodeList */ code_id , code_nm , code_value FROM zzz_code_info WHERE code_parent_id = #{codeParentId}
SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.api.AipMapper.getNextRequestSeq */ user_email, user_phone, user_nm FROM seinfo_vendor_manager WHERE user_role = 'ADMIN'

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.util.api.AipMapper.getNextRequestSeq */ b.user_email, b.user_nm, b.user_phone FROM seinfo_request a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.reg_user_id = b.user_email WHERE a.request_no = #{requestNo}
